paragraphs: The 525d is a six-cylinder diesel variant of the BMW 5 Series, produced across the F10/F11 generation from 2010 to 2017. It uses the N57 — a 3.0-litre straight-six turbodiesel that sits between the 520d and 530d in the diesel range. The N57 delivers strong torque and refined power delivery, making it a popular choice for owners who want six-cylinder performance with diesel economy. The 525d was discontinued when the G30/G31 generation arrived, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The 525d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
